# collect row types, vars, bounds types

with open(p) as f:
    sec=None
    for line in f:
        s=line.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith('*'): continue
        tok=s.split()
        if tok[0] in ['NAME','ROWS','COLUMNS','RHS','RANGES','BOUNDS','ENDATA']:
            sec=tok[0]; continue
        if sec=='ROWS': rows[tok[1]]=tok[0]
        elif sec=='COLUMNS':
            if len(tok)>=3 and tok[1]=='MARKER':
                if 'INTORG' in line: inint=True
                if 'INTEND' in line: inint=False
                continue
            v=tok[0]; vars.add(v)
            if inint: intvars.add(v)
        elif sec=='BOUNDS':
            bound_types[tok[0]]+=1
            if tok[0] in ('BV','LI','UI') and len(tok)>=3: intvars.add(tok[2])
print('rows',len(rows),Counter(rows.values()))
print('vars',len(vars),'intvars',len(intvars),'bound_types',bound_types)
# tail bounds
import itertools
print('\nBOUNDS excerpt')

        if n>40: break
